BODY:
ARCHITECT COMMAND — MINIMAL CONTROL LOOP FREEZE AND BUILD3 RESUMPTION

AUTHORITY=gpt:project-architect
HUMAN_DIRECTION=richard:operator
PRIORITY=P0
TASK_ID=DELIVERY_HARDENING
SUPERSEDES=all lower-authority interpretations that expand the Build3 control loop beyond the minimal mechanism below
DOES_NOT_SUPERSEDE=company:managing-director safety/authority rulings; this command is the project-level implementation of them

CANONICAL_CONTROL_LOOP — FREEZE THIS ARCHITECTURE:
1. Hermes executes exactly one bounded authorised task.
2. Hermes runs/refreshed Graphify when implementation changed structure or code, as already required.
3. Hermes commits and pushes the actual work.
4. That Git push deterministically wakes the exact bound receiving agent through the existing event-push transport.
5. The receiving agent consumes the exact committed control file exactly once by MESSAGE_ID.
6. The receiving agent writes its exact response/ruling as one deterministic control file, commits and pushes it.
7. That Git push deterministically wakes the exact bound originating agent.
8. The originating agent consumes that exact response file exactly once.
9. Controller issues the next bounded action, or Architect rules only when an Architect gate/escalation is genuinely required.

WORKER_TERMINATION_RULE — MECHANICAL:
Hermes MUST be mechanically unable to terminate/stand down while an authorised action, required response, or unconsumed ruling exists.
Only semantic consumption of an exact correlated DISPOSITION=STAND_DOWN_PERMISSION may permit stand-down.
STAND_DOWN_REQUEST is never permission.

ALLOWED_SUPPORTING MECHANICS:
- MESSAGE_ID exactly-once dedupe.
- Existing project/role/binding checks needed to wake the exact bound agent.
- Existing Graphify requirement.
- Existing durable state strictly necessary to preserve exactly-once delivery/restart safety.
- Existing deadman/recovery only as fallback, never normal-path discovery.
- Minimal observation/audit proving the canonical steps above occurred.

FORBIDDEN FROM THIS POINT:
- No new transport layer.
- No new ID/nonce namespace where an existing message/wake identity already exists.
- No new queue/store/database solely to prove another proof layer.
- No polling/watch loop as normal delivery.
- No architecture round-robin.
- No new provenance/ack/re-entry/health abstraction unless the current minimal loop literally cannot execute without it.
- No proof mechanism may become a second authority path.
- No Hermes design discretion.
- No repeated re-proving of already-passed Build3 product gates.
- No additional control semantics merely because they are theoretically desirable.

CURRENT SHARED-INFRA REPAIR BOUNDARY:
Finish ONLY the smallest already-authorised repair necessary to make the canonical loop actually work:
A. accepted canonical PAYLOAD reaches the message-bearing wake;
B. an uncertain POST cannot be falsely marked delivered;
C. existing wake/message identity is correlated to exact semantic consumption without inventing another identity/store;
D. exact response file returns through the same deterministic Git-push path.
Once A-D work in one real two-way cycle, STOP expanding control-plane work.

MANDATORY RESUME GATE:
Run ONE real end-to-end cycle:
Controller bounded directive file -> Graphify/implementation only if applicable -> commit/push -> exact Hermes wake -> exact directive consumed once -> Hermes response file -> commit/push -> exact Controller wake -> exact response consumed once.

PASS CONDITION:
REAL_TWO_WAY_FILE_PUSH=PASS
GRAPHIFY_HANDOFF_RULE=PASS
EXACTLY_ONCE=PASS
STANDDOWN_INTERLOCK=PASS

ON PASS:
Immediately resume Build3 product work from the preserved current state.
Do NOT wait for additional optional control-plane hardening.
Do NOT redo G2.
Resume G3 from the accepted candidate/correction state and execute the already-authorised minimal DURABLE_IN_FLIGHT_STATE_CLOBBER correction.
Then Controller adjudicates G3 and wakes Architect on PASS before G4.

ON FAILURE:
Return exactly ONE first failing seam in the canonical loop.
Do not design around it.
Do not add another subsystem.
Controller either issues one bounded repair or escalates that exact seam to Architect.

ROLE BOUNDARIES:
ARCHITECT=architecture/invariants/gates only.
CONTROLLER=inspect evidence, PASS/FAIL, issue next bounded action.
HERMES=implement/test/Graphify/commit/push/respond only.
RICHARD=not a routine relay.

ACTIVE_CONVERGENCE_REQUIRED=YES
NO_STAND_DOWN_WHILE_EXECUTABLE_NEXT_ACTION_EXISTS=YES
BUILD3_PRODUCT_SCOPE_BROADENING=NO
